verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a no-training policy, a training opt-out, or any commitment about how Activepieces or its AI providers use customer data for model training. The "bring your own AI keys" and self-hosting options are adjacent privacy and deployment controls, not a documented capability to prevent data from being used for training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
